name: saga-pack1-consumer-example
description: A synthetic notes application used to qualify the packed SDK artifacts (PACK1). It exists as two consumers built from one source: main-own.ts uses the application's own catalog alone, main-card.ts adds the optional FaithfulCard. It is not part of the npm workspace: scripts/build-pack1-consumers.ts installs the packed SDK packages into a clean copy of it and builds that.
